description: This Java class parses Atom XML feeds, extracting entries with id, title, link, and published date.

classes.name: FeedParser
classes.description: A class for parsing Atom XML feeds into Entry objects.

classes.name: FeedParser.Entry
classes.description: Represents a single feed entry with id, title, link, and published timestamp.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an InputStream containing an Atom feed and returns a list of Entry objects.

methods.name: readFeed
methods.description: Reads the feed element and extracts Entry objects.

methods.name: readEntry
methods.description: Parses an individual entry element into an Entry object.

methods.name: readTag
methods.description: Reads specific tags like id, title, published, or link.

methods.name: readBasicTag
methods.description: Reads simple XML tags with text content.

methods.name: readAlternateLink
methods.description: Processes link tags with rel='alternate' to extract href.

methods.name: readText
methods.description: Extracts text content from the current XML element.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Skips over XML tags not of interest.
